notes.title: Static 2.4 - Small Fix
notes.content: Fixed a never ending audio line on Floor 5.

notes.title: Static 2.3 - Optimization!
notes.content: Fixed a major bug where frame rates were not capped, this is now fixed and should run much smoother.

notes.title: Static 2.2
notes.content:
Made a few changes to make the game run better.
Fixed a bug where the player could not activate anything on Floor 5
Fixed a bug where the 3rd Static monster spawned you in the floor.

notes.title: The Static Re-Release is Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The day has finally arrived and we hope you will be able to enjoy Static with all your Valentines Day festivities! 
We hope you will enjoy the new content and achievements, be sure to let us know when you find some of the hidden ones!

Be sure to join our discord: https://discord.gg/SUjXUfmumx to keep up with all of our games, and to submit feedback directly to us!
We hope to have you all join us and we can't wait for you to experience Static in its brand new form!

notes.title: Static Re-Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are so excited to share with you that Static will be re-releasing with all of our improvements on February 14th! For those of you who already own Static, be sure to check out all the new features and gameplay elements we've added. For those of you who have had us on your wishlist, be sure to purchase Static now while it remains at the original price! The new Static update features improved map design, lighting, AI, new voice lines, new achievements, new game modes, and plenty more secrets hidden around.

We can't wait to share all of this with you very soon!

[previewyoutube=si7RiwiYLTY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Static is LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Static is now officially out, please let us know what you think in the discussions here, and if you enjoyed it please leave us a review, it really helps us out in terms of visibility and feedback! We will be actively monitoring the page should any of you have any issues. Over the next week we will begin talking about the free Ashes of Kanaka update and what you all can expect! Until then, enjoy Static, and thank you for playing!!

notes.title: Static Release Contest: Be a part of the Ashes Universe!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Sorry for the delay, we have been fighting with the last bit of bug testing the past few days, but now we are here to officially announce our contest for Static's release! The winner will not only win a free copy of Static, but we will work with you to make your name and likeness canon for the story! This means that once we begin to add the main character from Static into Ashes, that character will be YOU! All you'll need to do is share this link across social media platforms and you'll be automatically entered. We can't wait to share Static with you very soon!

notes.title: Static Nearing Release!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

It's hard to believe Static will be out in almost a week, we are finishing the last bit of polish and can't wait to share it with all of you! We are currently working on integrating it with Steam, as well as building Steam Achievements. We will be announcing the contest next week so keep your eyes peeled!!

notes.title: Static Development Blog!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Static is nearing completion as we continue to knock out the last of the polishing needed. Our CEO has been working on a development blog to help keep those interested involved by providing weekly updates on what is going on. You can find the start of these blogs here: https://www.dogwoodgaming.com/blog/2019/2/10/development-blog-static Please keep up with our progress there and share any thoughts you may have, we'd love to hear from you!

notes.title: Static is now listed on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Dogwood Gaming is proud to show off our newest title which will be coming to you very soon! We have a lot of things planned for the coming release of Static, as well as how it will impact our first title, Ashes of Kanaka. As mentioned in the description, on Static's release we will soon implement a FREE update to Ashes of Kanaka that will include a new companion joining you in your adventures. The main character from Static will be added to the Ashes world and in the next few days we will be announcing a contest we will be hosting where the winner will not only get to give the official name for the main character from Static, they will also choose their class in Ashes AND receive Static for free! So please keep your eyes peeled for our updates on the contest, and I will be posting new screenshots and information leading up to Static's release!
